atlas.title: Android Security Architecture
atlas.claim: Layered platform security constrains diagnostic and evidence-access paths.
atlas.versions: Reference as reviewed 2026-10-24; exact OS/SoC/firmware applicability requires a scoped experiment.
atlas.limitations: No physical-device validation, attestation, extraction or bypass capability is established. Public documentation is not a NEXVARY lab result.

atlas.title: iOS Security Architecture
atlas.claim: Apple documents hardware, system and data security as distinct layers.
atlas.versions: Reference as reviewed 2026-10-24; exact OS/SoC/firmware applicability requires a scoped experiment.
atlas.limitations: No physical-device validation, attestation, extraction or bypass capability is established. Public documentation is not a NEXVARY lab result.

atlas.title: Qualcomm SoC Architecture
atlas.claim: Qualcomm describes secure boot and a TEE separated from the high-level OS. Linux QTEE documentation describes SCM/SMCCC transport and object-based service communication.
atlas.versions: Qualcomm generic security overview and rolling latest Linux QTEE documentation reviewed 2026-10-24; no exact Snapdragon/OEM build accepted.
atlas.limitations: Published architecture does not establish USB mode access, debug authorization, attestation, key access or acquisition support. Determine the exact SoC and OEM kernel first; no phone was tested.

atlas.title: MediaTek SoC Architecture
atlas.claim: MediaTek publishes chipset-scoped security bulletins. Its Genio IoT documentation separately describes secure DRAM and OP-TEE storage; the architecture of an untested Dimensity/Helio phone remains a research hypothesis.
atlas.versions: October 2026 chipset bulletin and IoT Yocto v26.0/Genio documentation only; smartphone implementation unverified.
atlas.limitations: Genio IoT descriptions are not evidence about all MediaTek smartphones. OEM firmware patch adoption, exact TEE, USB interfaces and device compatibility require separate documentation and owned-device tests. No fuse/RPMB provisioning procedure is implemented.

atlas.title: Samsung Knox
atlas.claim: Samsung documents a ROM-rooted boot chain, TrustZone secure-world separation and Knox Vault on selected devices. Hardware-bound keys and rollback state constrain repair and integrity interpretation.
atlas.versions: Samsung Hardware-Backed Security page dated 2025-03-07, reviewed 2026-10-24; exact device/Knox generation must be checked.
atlas.limitations: Knox Vault is not universal across Samsung models. No device attestation, fuse measurement, protected-key access or phone acquisition was tested. A reported boot property cannot certify Knox integrity.
